name: Deadlock
summary: A two-player social dilemma where each player has a dominant defect strategy and the mutual defection equilibrium is Pareto optimal.
rules_text: Deadlock is a symmetric 2x2 normal-form game. Two players simultaneously choose one of two labeled actions, commonly called Cooperate and Defect. Each receives a payoff determined by the pair of choices. The payoffs satisfy c > d > a > b for Player 1 and x > z > w > y for Player 2 in the general form, for example: mutual cooperation gives 1,1; unilateral defection gives 3,0; mutual defection gives 2,2. Thus Defect strictly dominates Cooperate for both players. The unique Nash equilibrium is mutual defection. Unlike Prisoner's Dilemma, this equilibrium is Pareto optimal, so there is no gain from moving to mutual cooperation. Play is one-shot.
rating_reason: Deadlock is specific 2-player social dilemma payoff game
